name: The AanuBlooms Signature 5-Piece Blossom Garden Pots Set

reviews.author: Pooja Sharma
reviews.title: Unbelievable quality and finish!
reviews.comment: The set of 5 potted flowers arrived in perfect shape in Bangalore. The fairy lights and Aanu Blooms card made it feel so personal!

name: Everlasting Pink Tulip & Daisy Handcrafted Bouquet
shortDescription: Romantic hand-crocheted bouquet of blushing pink tulips, chamomile daisies, and eucalyptus stems.
description: Never wilting, always blooming. Each blossom in this bouquet is meticulously hand-crocheted using 100% premium combed milk cotton yarn. Mounted on flexible floral wire stems, you can shape and arrange the bouquet effortlessly in any vase. Wrapped in kraft wrapping paper and finished with a satin ribbon bow, it arrives completely gift-ready for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, or home styling.
careInstructions: Gently dust with a soft brush or hairdryer on cool setting. Spot clean with a damp cloth if needed. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight to maintain vibrant color.

reviews.author: Ananya Sharma
reviews.title: Breathtaking in person! Never wilts!
reviews.comment: I gifted this to my mom for her birthday in Bangalore and she loved it. The stitches are so uniform and tight!

reviews.author: Rohan Verma
reviews.title: Perfect 1st anniversary flower
reviews.comment: My partner loves flowers but hated seeing them wilt. This bouquet looks amazing on our table.

name: Sunny Sunshine Crochet Sunflower in Ceramic Pot
shortDescription: Cheerful blooming sunflower inside a mini terracotta ceramic base with textured seed center.

reviews.author: Pooja Hegde
reviews.title: Such a mood booster for my work desk
reviews.comment: Everyone in my office compliments this little sunflower. Sturdy pot and cheerful blooms!

name: Strawberry Milk Chubby Amigurumi Bunny Plushie
shortDescription: Ultra-soft squishy handmade bunny crocheted with premium chenille velvet yarn with strawberry backpack.
description: Meet Berry! This irresistibly cute bunny is handcrafted from high-density plush chenille velvet yarn that feels like a cloud to hug. Filled with hypoallergenic polyfill and fitted with safety-locked bead eyes (or embroidered eyes upon request for babies). Features floppy ears and an adorable removable strawberry backpack.
careInstructions: Hand wash with baby shampoo in lukewarm water. Gently squeeze (do not wring) and air dry on a mesh rack.

reviews.author: Sneha Patel
reviews.title: So incredibly soft and squishy!
reviews.comment: The chenille yarn is so luxurious. The strawberry backpack is functional and holds tiny trinkets. Love Aanu's work!
